items.html: And the matter is that now, before Chatzot, the NHY of Ima enter within Leah to enlarge her, while she is still at the back, and they enter little by little; and the completion of the time of their entry is at Chatzot of the night precisely, for then they spread until the end of the feet of Rachel, and everything is finished to be made into one Partzuf, as mentioned. And everything is called by the name of Leah, and at Chatzot Leah returns face to face, and behold she is long in the entire measure of the stature of ZA, through what she takes on loan from Rachel, as mentioned; and then she couples with Yaakov, as explained above, and so it will be explained further, with God's help.
